name: pl_playlist_items
description: Fetch items for a given Premier League content playlist from the public playlist API.

operations.js: (() => { try { const text = document.body && document.body.innerText ? document.body.innerText : null; if (!text) { return { ok: false, error: 'No body text found' }; } const parsed = JSON.parse(text); return parsed; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: String(e) }; } })();

parameters.name: playlistId
parameters.description: Playlist identifier as used by the Premier League content API (e.g., 4346308).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items to return in the playlist page.
